fusions.name: Off the Ledge
fusions.desc: Butts a wounded enemy for 22 damage and leaves it [Sundered] for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Planted Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps an iron-shod hoof, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Moves Me
fusions.desc: For 5 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Crag-Footed
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% rock resistance.
